name: PM Toolkit — KodaSōken
description: Reusable templates for product management in Japanese healthcare AI. Lightweight, startup-focused.

product-brief.description: One-pager for a new product or major feature. Use before committing engineering resources.

sections.prompt: Working title for this product/feature
What user/customer behavior change will this drive? (One sentence)
What problem are we solving? Evidence this problem exists (user quotes, data, market signal).
Target user segment. Be specific: 'primary care physicians in clinics with 3+ doctors in Tokyo metro' not 'doctors'.
What are we building? 3–5 sentences. Include key differentiator vs current alternatives.
非医療機器 / 医療機器 Class I–IV / SaMD? If unclear, note 'needs PMDA pre-consultation'.
How will we know this worked? 2–3 measurable leading indicators.
Top 3 risks (technical, clinical, regulatory, market). For each: likelihood (L/M/H) and mitigation.
What must be true to proceed? What would make us kill this?
Now / Next / Later estimate. No dates. '~6 weeks to prototype, ~12 weeks to pilot-ready.'
Who needs to approve? Who needs to be informed? (RACI lite)

feature-spec.description: Lightweight spec for a feature that's been prioritized into Now or Next. Not a PRD — a conversation starter.

sections.prompt: Short, descriptive name
What user behavior change does this drive? Link to which OKR/KR.
As a [user], I want to [action] so that [outcome]. One primary story, optional secondary.
What happens today? Screenshot or 2-sentence description of current workflow.
What changes? Key interaction. Can be a sketch, wireframe link, or 5 bullet points.
What breaks? Error states, empty states, loading states. Clinical edge cases (rare diseases, drug interactions).
3–5 checkable conditions that mean 'done.' Include clinical accuracy threshold if applicable.
What are we explicitly NOT building? Prevents scope creep.
What needs to be in place? EMR API, model fine-tuning, regulatory clearance, data access.
Person-weeks. From engineering, not PM.

competitive-matrix.description: Schema for tracking competitors and feature comparison.

players.name: Competitor name
players.category: e.g., symptom checker, EMR vendor, AI chatbot, consulting
players.funding_stage: Seed / Series A / Public / Division of large corp

user-interview-guide.description: 30-minute semi-structured interview guide for Japanese physician research.

prep: Review physician's clinic profile (size, specialty, EMR system)
Confirm recording consent (required for medical context)
Have product ready for demo (if applicable)
rapport_5min: Thank them for time. Explain purpose: 'we're learning how physicians work, not selling anything'
Ask about their practice: '何名くらいの患者さんを診られていますか?'
Ask about their typical day: '今日はどんな一日でしたか?'
context_10min: Walk me through your last consultation from start to finish: '最後の診察を最初から最後まで教えてください'
Probe: What tools did you use? What slowed you down? What did you do after the patient left?
Probe: Documentation — when, how, how long? 'カルテはいつ書かれますか?'
deep_dive_10min: Identify the biggest friction point from context and go deep
Ask about past attempts to solve it: 'この問題に対して、何か試されたことはありますか?'
Ask about ideal state: '魔法の杖があったら、どう変わりますか?'
demo_if_applicable_5min: 'これを見て、最初にどう思われますか?' (What's your first impression?)
'実際の診察で使うとしたら、どこが一番気になりますか?' (What would concern you most in real practice?)
close_5min: Any other feedback? '他に何かありますか?'
Ask for referrals: '同じような課題をお持ちの先生をご存知ですか?'
post_interview: Write What? So What? Now What? within 1 hour
Note any product ideas that emerged (but don't commit to building them)

prioritization-matrix.description: RICE-based prioritization matrix for feature scoring.

items.cost_of_delay: None / Low / Medium / High / Critical — with reason
